TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings directly relevant enterprise network and data-centre delivery experience aligned to PITB’s requirement for supply, installation, configuration, commissioning, and knowledge transfer across multiple sites, backed by mature governance and security controls. We are ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified, supporting PITB’s mandatory compliance expectations for information security and quality management [CO-PROFILE]. We are also incorporated as a (Pvt) Ltd and registered with FBR with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, meeting the stated tax/registration requirement [CO-PROFILE].

Closest-match past performance in enterprise network design and deployment includes:
- Network Design Deployment (PKR 182M, 21 months, completed 2022) [CAP-009]
- Network Design Deployment (PKR 44M, 21 months, completed 2025) [CAP-021]
- Network Design Deployment (PKR 133M, 36 months, completed 2020) [CAP-033]
These engagements evidence that we have successfully executed well above the RFP threshold of at least two enterprise network/data-centre projects valued at not less than PKR 30M within the last five years [CAP-009] [CAP-021] [CAP-033].

For adjacent complex, multi-stakeholder IT infrastructure delivery (including regulated environments), we have delivered large-scale hospital IT deployments for Federal Government and international clients (PKR 182M, 15 months, completed 2020; PKR 154M, 19 months, completed 2020; PKR 64M, 33 months, completed 2022) [CAP-042] [CAP-006] [CAP-030].

On warranty support and bid security: our fact sheet evidences an in-country support desk with 24–48h response SLAs and the ability to arrange CDR/bank guarantee from scheduled banks up to our facility limit, supporting PITB’s bid security requirement [CO-PROFILE]. Our library does not yet evidence a 4-hour on-site response commitment or OEM certifications for assigned engineers; we will address this in the final execution plan through OEM-authorised resourcing and PITB-agreed, site-wise escalation and response commitments.
